THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Hot Honey Mustard Hack Sauce

2 ingredients. 60 seconds. Money Mustard's lazy cousin.

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIME1 min
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~25 cal | ~0g protein

Ingredients

Ingredients

  • 30g French's Organic Yellow Mustard
  • 10g ChocZero Keto Hot Honey

You want the sweet-tangy-spicy honey mustard hit without making the full 8-ingredient Money Mustard batch. Single-serve, one bowl, 60 seconds, ~25 cal. This is Money Mustard's lazy cousin — same flavor lane, 1/10 the complexity.

Method

  1. 1.BOWL. 30g French's yellow mustard into a small dipping bowl or ramekin.
  2. 2.DRIZZLE. 10g ChocZero Keto Hot Honey on top of the mustard.
  3. 3.STIR. Whisk or stir with a fork until fully smooth and glossy — no streaks of honey on top, no mustard pockets at the bottom. Should be the texture of warm honey mustard, not paste.
  4. 4.SERVE. Straight into the dip. Best with air-fryer chicken nuggets, chicken tenders, breaded chicken chunks, or roasted potatoes. Eat immediately — this is a fresh-make sauce, not a meal-prep batch.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult: Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid: Serve the kid portion as described above.

If something fails

Sauce is too sharp / mustard-forward: Push the ChocZero up — 12-15g hot honey balances the tang. Macros only climb ~5 cal per extra 3g of ChocZero.

Not sweet enough: Either use more ChocZero (15g instead of 10g) or sub a less-tangy mustard (Dijon adds depth without the same sharpness).

Not enough heat: ChocZero's heat is subtle — for a bigger kick, swap 5g of the ChocZero for 5g of Taste Flavor Co Hot Honey Sriracha (cross-recipe with the full Money Mustard recipe).

Too thick / paste-like: Add 1-2 tsp warm water and stir. Should be pourable like warm honey mustard, not toothpaste.

Sauce broke / separated on the plate: Either you didn't whisk it fully (re-stir) or the mustard was very cold while the honey was room temp. Both at fridge temp = smooth blend.

Storage and reheating

Store: Best fresh — make per serving. The 2-ingredient ratio is so simple there's no benefit to batching.

Reheat: No reheat — use cold straight from fridge or room temp.

Lasts: If you must store: covered in fridge 2-3 days. After that the mustard starts to separate and the chili-warmth fades.

Estimated nutrition

~25 cal | ~0g protein.

Per-serving (~25 cal / 0g protein / 0g fat / ~3g net carbs / ~1g fiber). Component breakdown: 30g French's Organic Yellow Mustard ≈ 9 cal / 0P / 0F / 1C + 10g ChocZero Keto Hot Honey ≈ 15 cal / 0P / 0F / 7C total / 5g fiber → 2 net C. Headline total: 24 cal / 3 net carbs / 1g fiber. Negligible protein/fat. Push the ChocZero up to 15g and the sauce climbs to ~30 cal / 4 net C — still a macro-light dip. The Money Mustard equivalent at the same ~25g per-serving size lands ~32 cal / 3g protein — more protein but more complexity. This Hack version is the 'I have 60 seconds' lane.

Core ratio — locked

3:1 mustard to hot honey. 30g mustard + 10g ChocZero Hot Honey is the system. Push the honey up for sweeter/stickier; hold at 10g for the macro-friendly anchor.

Flavor target

First taste: tangy yellow-mustard bite. Mid: ChocZero sweetness softens the sharpness. Finish: slow habanero warmth that builds 5-10 sec after the bite. Reads like Chick-fil-A sauce — without the sugar or the eight-ingredient prep.

Adult plate | Kid plate

Adult plate

Adult

Full ratio as written — 30g mustard + 10g ChocZero Hot Honey. The habanero finish is the point.

Kid plate

Kid

Skip the ChocZero Hot Honey (habanero kick — kids spit it back). Sub 5g plain honey or 5g maple syrup for the same sweet-tangy lift without the heat. Or just serve plain yellow mustard.

Brands I use

French's
Organic Yellow Mustard
Clean, consistent tang without weird additives. The 30g base of the sauce — its sharpness gets balanced by the ChocZero. Cross-recipe with the full Money Mustard recipe.
ChocZero
Keto Hot Honey (sugar-free, monk-fruit sweetened, with habanero peppers)
Sugar-free hot honey alternative — soluble corn fiber + monk fruit + red chili peppers. 1:1 sub for traditional hot honey without the sugar load. The 10g portion adds the sweet-heat layer that turns plain yellow mustard into honey-mustard. Cross-recipe with Money Mustard.
